purpose: Define group governance with immutable owner, two delegated permission levels and explicit optional all-members-may-invite policy.

topics.name: Group Roles and Invites
topics.purpose: Define group governance with immutable owner, two delegated permission levels and explicit optional all-members-may-invite policy.

semantics.role_rule: Delegated levels are explicit group-governance permissions and do not alter IdentityCore identity.
semantics.invite_rule: Invites require an explicitly permitted group role or policy.
semantics.all_may_invite_rule: A group may explicitly enable all-members-may-invite.
semantics.default_rule: All-members-may-invite is not assumed unless enabled.
semantics.membership_rule: Invite acceptance creates explicit group membership.
semantics.authority_rule: Group role authority applies only to group-governance operations and does not grant unrelated AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: Messaging identity, conversation state, throttling, group governance and transport semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: invite accepted without explicit membership transition
group role grants unrelated AccessCore authority

references.purpose: Governance applies to explicit group identity.
Group permissions are scoped authority semantics.
